title: Every voice and chat surface on one permanent page: where it is, what runs it, who answers

chat.text: You asked for the page that shows how the drawer, the mobile sheet, the sidebar conversation, the session card chat, the dictation widget and the refine views fit together. A Sonnet task mastermind builds it as a permanent page under ux/Dictate: a screenshot of each surface with its one name, where it appears, the file that renders it, the agent that answers and the log it writes; one flow diagram; the measured cause of the 30-second first reply; the duplicates named. The inbox note will only link it.
